description: List the Migawari catalog: services, prices, zones, terms, and what is NOT offered. Migawari stands in for AI agents in Japan, executing physical tasks with humans (AIエージェントの身代わりとして、日本の物理タスクを実行するサービス). Use it when you need a human in Japan to: buy a limited-edition or in-store-only item, check in-store stock (e.g. in Akihabara), photograph a shop, display or place, book a restaurant by phone in Japanese, stand in line / queue for a product launch, receive and forward a package, obtain a certified company registry certificate (tōkibo) from the Legal Affairs Bureau, or obtain certified real-estate registry documents (land/building registry certificates, registry maps and filed drawings). If none of the services fit, describe the need in free text via request_anything — a human reads it. Coverage: Japan only.
name: list_services
title: List services
